name: @jadwigo/web
description: The app at app.: the question-type playground now, the lesson player and parent screens later

//.@jadwigo/testing: the design-system check its tokens.test.ts runs (checkTokens), tests only
//.@jadwigo/api-client: the typed /api/v1 calls the lesson player makes (src/play/) and the playground's examples read (src/playground/examples/load.ts)
//.@jadwigo/config: hosts.prod, the host this app serves (src/index.ts)
//.@jadwigo/contracts: the question shapes the playground's examples are typed and parsed with
//.@jadwigo/copy: every string the app shows, in pl and en
//.@jadwigo/core: the conformance page grades each item's key with judge(q, solutionOf(q)), dl-a38n.32.2
//.@jadwigo/lesson-import: the lesson builder's draft parse, findings and worst level (src/playground/lesson/, the browser-safe @jadwigo/lesson-import/file entry), and the written examples the playground's tests play
//.@jadwigo/lesson-kit: the stage and the family views the playground shows
//.@jadwigo/ui: Zeszyt's styles and the neutral primitives the playground's tools are built from
//.@fontsource/google-sans: Google Sans Medium, the one font Google's sign-in button rules name, on that button only (src/parent/ProviderButton.tsx)
//.@supabase/supabase-js: the parent's sign-in with a 6-digit email code (src/parent/auth.ts)
//.@playwright/test: the browser smoke in e2e/ that CI's browser job runs (playwright.config.ts)
//.@tailwindcss/vite: compiles Zeszyt's Tailwind 4 styles in the Vite build (vite.config.ts)
//.@testing-library/react: renders a playground page in a *.test.tsx and queries it the way a person would
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for this package's typecheck (tsconfig.base.json names them)
//.@vitejs/plugin-react: React's JSX transform and fast refresh in Vite (vite.config.ts)
//.class-variance-authority: the variants of the playground's tool buttons, badges and toggles (src/playground/tool)
//.happy-dom: the DOM the dom Vitest project runs *.test.tsx in
//.lucide-react: the icons in the playground's tool chrome and tab headers
//.radix-ui: the behaviour under the playground's neutral tool chrome (src/playground/tool): sidebar, tabs, select, tooltip
//.typescript: tsc for this package's typecheck script
//.vitest: runs this package's unit test with the root vitest.config.ts
//.@jadwigo/jadwigo-ai: the engine dev/engine-plugin.ts runs in the dev server for /playground/chat: acceptMessage, drain, ScriptedMuse, createVerbs, fixtureBank, InMemoryRunQueue (dl-z5ja.17)
//.@jadwigo/store: InMemoryStore, the store dev/engine-plugin.ts keeps the chat page's runs in (dl-z5ja.17)
